name: MAC Matchmaster SPF 15 Foundation NC15 – Natural Matte Finish, Medium Buildable Coverage, Oil-Free, Long-Wearing, Shade-Adapting Technology
description: Achieve a flawless, naturally polished complexion with the MAC Matchmaster SPF 15 Foundation in NC15, designed with advanced tone-adapting technology to match your skin like never before. Powered by Shade Intelligence Technology, this modern foundation uses light-altering pigments that adjust to the unique undertones of your skin, offering the most natural match possible.The foundation provides medium, buildable coverage with a comfortable natural matte finish, effectively minimizing shine without making skin look dry or flat. Its oil-free formula helps control excess oil throughout the day, making it ideal for normal, oily, or combination skin.With SPF 15 broad-spectrum UVA/UVB protection, it shields your skin from harmful sun exposure while offering breathable, long-wearing performance for up to 8 hours. Dermatologist and ophthalmologist tested, it is safe for daily use and suitable even for sensitive or acne-prone skin.Packaged in a generous 60mL bottle, this foundation offers double the usual quantity—perfect for professional use, bridal makeup, or those who love long-lasting value.
